outcome: See every sensor, plant and device where it is in your rooms, and how warm, bright and humid each room is, as a map.

views.title: Floor plan dashboard
views.condition: domosenso floorplan push creates the floorplan dashboard; every user can read it, an administrator edits rooms and positions on it.
views.layout: Native Home Assistant dashboard; zoom and pan by wheel, pinch or buttons; editing on a desktop or tablet.

views.title: Floor plan on the wall
views.condition: Set floorplan: true in Ramka 0.10.0 or later with the floorplan dashboard pushed; a sideways swipe on the controls shows the plan and back. floorplan_layers lists its layers, one shown at a time; with floorplan 0.3.0 and Ramka 0.11.0 the plants, climate and light layers have maps, now or the last 24 hours, and the plan fills the screen.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

setup: Add the component and trace your rooms from an architect's plan or a photo of one with the floorplan-from-image skill; the drawing stays in your home repository.
Push the plan with domosenso floorplan push, then drag sensors, plants and devices to where they stand in edit mode, or against your real home with floorplan preview.
Optionally show it on the Ramka with floorplan: true, and mark rooms open to each other without doors as one open space so their maps share readings.

states.label: Temperature
states.headline: A warm living room, a cool office
states.detail: Fictional values: each room is coloured from its own placed sensors; a room without one is hatched.

states.label: Light
states.headline: Where the plants get light
states.detail: The light map, now or the brightest hour of the last 24 hours from Home Assistant's statistics; night is always dark, so the 24 h figure is the useful one.

states.label: Open space
states.headline: One open space, one map
states.detail: Living room and kitchen have no door between them: marked as one open space, they share their readings and the kitchen is no longer hatched.
